//! `<T>::now()` — the owning type is in the qualified self and the source
//! text carries no `SystemTime::now` substring at all.

fn base_s() -> i64 {
    std::time::SystemTime::now()
        .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)
        .expect("clock")
        .as_secs() as i64
}

fn a_case() -> std::time::SystemTime {
    <std::time::SystemTime>::now()
}
